reviewer_type: Author visual review and simulated learner critique; not actual student testing
verdict: Accepted for all nine authored base-case lessons within the recorded coverage; no material visual blocker observed
calculator_result: Passed exact expected JSON and derived-value verification after final visual inspection

harness.numeric_format: auto; authored raw values and visible formatting checked separately

settled_visual_review.method: Every state in all four profiles inspected through exact scene crops and legible contact sheets; representative full figures inspected for controls, explanatory prose, metrics, caption, and surrounding chapter context. Original PNG hashes below identify the full captures. Narrow scenes were inspected at native 282px width; desktop contacts use 500px state columns with native crops available.
settled_visual_review.capture_method: Actual emitted chapter pages with native Explore controls. Harness captures full figure height by enlarging screenshot viewport as needed; normal page scrolling is required in narrow profiles. The global back-to-top button is hidden for capture as documented by the harness.

motion_review.own_method: Native Next then native K pause around45percent; exact screenshot of actual chapter scene, no runtime interception or data/state overrides. Back-to-top button hidden as in independent harness; original chapter assets unchanged.

pilot_deep_review.coverage: CNN weighted products and second reduction; KV projection/decode and retained-cache read. Three sampled pause times (250/400/650ms), four profiles, 48 independently inspected motion PNGs. Same author JSON, runtime JS, CSS, and lesson bundle as this final build; clean separately built actual chapter.

shared_controls.scope: Shared control and runtime regression evidence is recorded separately. This report adds own lesson state coverage and selected motion; it does not duplicate every shared control check.

findings.finding: Source weights remain resident while copied tile and successive input rows produce separate output rows. Fetch accounting does not silently repeat for the second row.
findings.simulated_learner_critique: Can distinguish what is reused from what changes; scope makes the tiny resident tile assumption explicit.

findings.finding: Backward computation and last-consumer activation release are distinct states. Byte strings and retained ownership remain legible in the narrow two-column activation pool.
findings.simulated_learner_critique: The starting point is explicitly end-forward; this explains the initial allocations without implying a full training trace.

findings.finding: Four paired weighted contributions precede separate reduction and output write. Second reduction retains the committed accumulator while incoming values occupy a separate dock; input and shared kernel stay visible.
findings.simulated_learner_critique: A reader can trace a selected patch through products to its written output, then see the spatial shift with the same kernel.

findings.finding: Each channel computes its own spatial intermediate before either output mixes across channels. Intermediate and output numbers match the calculator.
findings.simulated_learner_critique: The intermediates explain the factorization; no arbitrary numerical equality with a standard layer is asserted.

findings.finding: Successive lowered rows copy from the retained input with declared source indices, then the completed matrix feeds GEMM. Dense narrow numeric values remain intact.
findings.simulated_learner_critique: Copying exposes duplication rather than pretending lowering is a free reshape.

findings.finding: Prompt cache positions and Request A ownership remain visible during projection, non-destructive read copies, attention, append, and emission. Symbolic identities remain intact at narrow width.
findings.simulated_learner_critique: The current-pass chamber, persistent cache, and read copies answer different questions; the emitted token is not shown as cached before being consumed.

findings.finding: All twelve addresses fit one continuous row. A/B/C/D owners and free styling remain distinguishable; release preserves reserved capacity and the blocked request preserves existing contents.
findings.simulated_learner_critique: Visible holes show why aggregate reusable capacity alone cannot satisfy the contiguous request under the declared fixed-pool policy.

findings.finding: Host and device lanes advance through dependent eager work, then a single fused submission with equal arithmetic results. Abstract schedule units are explicitly scoped.
findings.simulated_learner_critique: The scene explains which host dependency disappears without presenting toy timings as measured performance.

findings.finding: Actual successive reads populate persistent read trails through each layout’s physical addresses, with old storage values retained. Address labels survive responsive wrapping.
findings.simulated_learner_critique: The same logical row yields adjacent row-major offsets and strided column-major offsets; no cache transaction claim is needed.

findings.finding: The secondary Incoming dock label can wrap in a dense narrow cell during sampled travel; numeric payloads and retained values remain readable. It does not obscure the source, destination identity, or causal result.

limits: No real learners participated and no learning outcome is measured. Simulated critique is reviewer judgment.
All authored base cases and states are covered; these nine lessons declare no additional selectable cases. No invented variant coverage is claimed.
Motion review samples one nontrivial action per nonpilot lesson in each profile, plus the separate deeper CNN/KV pilot samples. It does not inspect every instant of every transition.
Temporary screenshots and raw local browser reports are identified by basenames and hashes; they are not all checked into the public repository.

During travel a carrier may briefly coincide with an Incoming arrival dock; reviewed samples preserve the committed value and numeric payload. Narrow dense secondary Incoming text can wrap without splitting the payload.
Actual browser document.hidden behavior was not established by this state suite; consult shared runtime regressions for explicit inconclusive visibility coverage.
Tall figures require normal scrolling; complete narrow figures and controls are not simultaneously visible. No acceptance overlay or generated replacement page was used.
